canary-notebook-authoring.body:
# Jupyter notebook tests with canary-notebook

## Overview

The `canary-notebook` plugin discovers `.ipynb` files and runs each notebook as a single canary test case. All code cells are executed sequentially in one live Jupyter kernel. A test fails if any cell raises an unhandled exception.

Query the plugin's capability data:

```console
canary query -c ext.notebook.overview
canary query -c ext.notebook.cell_markers
canary query -c ext.notebook.cli_options
```

## Running notebook tests

```console
# Run all notebooks in a directory
canary run path/to/notebooks/

# Run a specific notebook
canary run path/to/my_notebook.ipynb

# Use the current Python environment's kernel
canary run --notebook-current-env path/to/notebook.ipynb

# Use a named kernel
canary run --notebook-kernel-name python3 path/to/notebook.ipynb

# Disable output comparison
canary run --notebook-dont-compare-outputs path/to/notebook.ipynb

# Set per-cell timeout (seconds)
canary run --notebook-cell-timeout 120 path/to/notebook.ipynb
```

## Cell markers

Control per-cell behavior with comment markers at the top of each cell:

```python
# [skip: true]
# This cell is not executed at all
expensive_setup()
```

```python
# [check_output: false]
# Output is non-deterministic; do not compare against stored outputs
import datetime
print(datetime.datetime.now())
```

```python
# [allow_failure: true]
# This cell may raise an exception; the test continues regardless
risky_operation()
```

```python
# [raises: ValueError]
# This cell must raise ValueError; any other outcome fails the test
raise ValueError("expected")
```

```python
# [timeout: 30]
# This cell has a 30-second execution timeout (overrides global default)
long_running_computation()
```

## Sanitizing non-deterministic output

Create a YAML config file to normalize output before comparison:

```yaml
# sanitize.yaml
notebook:
  sanitize:
    - regex: '\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}'
      replace: 'TIMESTAMP'
    - regex: '0x[0-9a-fA-F]+'
      replace: '0xADDR'
```

Then run:

```console
canary run --notebook-config sanitize.yaml path/to/notebook.ipynb
```

## Output comparison

- By default, cell outputs are compared against the outputs stored in the notebook file.
- The following fields are always excluded: `metadata`, `traceback`, `prompt_number`, `output_type`, `name`, `execution_count`, widget view IDs, `image/png`, `image/jpeg`.
- Use `[check_output: false]` on individual cells for non-deterministic output.
- Use `--notebook-dont-compare-outputs` to disable comparison globally.

## Important rules

- The notebook is a single test case — not one test per cell.
- All cells share one kernel; state from earlier cells persists into later ones.
- `.ipynb_checkpoints/` directories are automatically excluded from collection.
- `--notebook-current-env` and `--notebook-kernel-name` are mutually exclusive.
- The default cell timeout is 2000 seconds (effectively unlimited). Override with `--notebook-cell-timeout T`.

## Useful queries

```console
canary query -c ext.notebook.cell_markers
canary query -c ext.notebook.cli_options
canary query -c ext.notebook.sanitize_config
canary query -c ext.notebook.output_skip_list
canary query -c ext.notebook.kernel_selection
```
